text: A student must accumulate a minimum of 144 academic credits plus 12 non-graded core units for the award of the BTech degree in Computer Science and Engineering.
A student must earn 12 units of non-graded core (NC) courses through prescribed formal and informal co-curricular activities (including NCN100 Wellbeing and NSS/NSO).
Students in BTech CSE must complete a minimum of 40.5 credits of Institute Core (IC) courses.
Students in BTech CSE must complete a minimum of 52 credits of Program Core (PC) courses.
Students in BTech CSE must complete a minimum of 22.5 credits of Program Elective (PE) courses.
Students in BTech CSE must complete a minimum of 15 credits of Open Elective (OE) courses.
Students in BTech CSE must complete a minimum of 10 credits of Liberal Arts (LA) courses.
The standard maximum semester credit registration is bounded by the curriculum template load, typically not exceeding 22.0 credits per regular semester.
A student must register for a minimum course load of 12.0 credits in any regular semester to maintain full-time undergraduate standing.
Each course may specify prerequisite courses. A student who has obtained an F, FS, I, or X grade in a prerequisite course is not eligible to register for the course.
If a course has more than 25% overlapping content with another course already credited by the student, the student is not eligible to register for that course.
BTech students can take V-type courses (lectures by external experts or approved NPTEL courses, 1-2 credits each, running >= 1 month) up to a maximum of 6 credits during the entire program.
The credits earned for any course are valid for up to 7 years only and shall not be counted towards degree requirements if acquired earlier than 7 years.
For employment or external certification requirements, an IIT Bhilai graduate having 6.0 CGPA and above is certified as First Class.
